تصطدمين (form VIII)
# تَصْطَدِمِينَ (taṣṭadimīna) /tasˤ.tˤa.di.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# تُصْطَدَمِينَ (tuṣṭadamīna) /tusˤ.tˤa.da.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
